title: Signals and drachmas
summary: The scanner now finds signal sources: glowing paths lead to them, and each opens onto an empty pocket of space with an encounter. Help a stranded freighter, save one under attack, loot a shipwreck, fight the Void Leviathan, scan an anomaly for research data or thread a deathtrap field to its exit. The Leviathan is drawn and animated in detail and fires bullet-hell patterns of energy orbs, hard to dodge but always survivable. Dying now respawns you at the nearest station with your progress kept, for your cargo and a tenth of your credits. Left alone, the title screen plays the game itself under a blinking arcade-Greek PLEASE INSERT DRACHMA and an old-CRT look, and the CRT filter is now in Settings with its own page. Fixes: the creature's orbs broke clicking, followed ships flew back and forth, dialogues kept the mouse hidden, and the voices are 50 % louder.

steps.title: Signal sources
steps.text: The scanner now finds signal sources. When a system scan ends it locates the system's three or four signals, 4,500 to 12,500 from the star, each a different encounter. Glowing dashed paths flow from your ship to each one and fade away with the scan's arrows. A pulsing beacon stays at every located signal, on the radar and the system map too, with an ENTER button over it: close by you drop straight in, from farther away your ship flies there first. Signals come and go with time (every 1,200 s of galaxy time), but ones you've found and not finished are kept.

steps.title: Six encounters
steps.text: Each signal leads to an empty pocket of space with no star, planets or stations, only the deep sky, and an encounter of its own. Help a stranded freighter (sometimes it's bait for pirates), save a freighter under attack, pick through a shipwreck's loot, kill an alien creature, scan an anomaly from four sides for research data, or thread a deathtrap field to its exit. A panel above the toolbar says what's going on and holds the action and Leave buttons. Flying 7,000 out also leaves, and you're put back beside the beacon. It's all played in a far corner of the same space scene, so weapons, loot, saving and the HUD work as usual.

steps.title: The Void Leviathan
steps.text: The alien creature is drawn and animated in detail. Eight tentacles move in travelling waves, with glowing tips. Its fins beat and the plates along its body undulate, with a pulse running down its veins. Four eyes track you and blink, and its mandibles open as energy gathers in its maw. It attacks in bullet-hell patterns of glowing energy orbs: rings, two-armed spirals, aimed fans and curving blooms. Each pattern follows a 0.7-second charge, 1.6 seconds apart. The orbs are slower than you, and the gaps in a ring are about twice the width of your hitbox, so every pattern is hard to dodge but possible.

steps.title: The deathtrap field
steps.text: The deathtrap is a field of pulsing, crackling space anomalies, 5,200 by 3,600. A winding seven-leg safe line runs from the entry to the exit, and hazards (radius 140-230) fill the rest of the field wherever they stay clear of it. Inside one, your shields drain at 45 a second, then the hull: steady damage with a crackle twice a second. Reach the glowing exit ring for alien alloy, a data core and 400-700 credits. Flying out of the sides gets you out alive but with nothing.

steps.title: Fix: followed ships flew back and forth
steps.text: Following a ship for a minute, it seemed to lose its mind. Your ship was holding steady 240 behind, but the ships themselves wandered by picking a random point 100-450 from home every time they reached one, reversing every few seconds. Patrolling warships and pirates now fly a circuit of four to six waypoints 700-1,400 around home, always in the same direction. Explorers pick their next destination ahead of them rather than behind. Measured over 90 seconds of following, reversals dropped from 10-19 to 0-1.

steps.title: Fix: dialogues kept the mouse; louder voices
steps.text: Holding the left button in space steers your ship and hides the cursor until you let go. If a story dialogue opened meanwhile, its dimmed backdrop took the release, so the game never saw it and the cursor stayed hidden. A dialogue now ends steering and shows the cursor, and steering also ends whenever the button isn't actually held. The voices are 50 % louder: every line is levelled to -14.5 LUFS instead of -18, with peaks kept at -1 dBFS so nothing clips, and all 78 lines were re-recorded.

steps.title: Respawn keeps your progress
steps.text: Dying no longer throws your game away. The game-over panel's Restart button started a brand-new game. It's now Respawn: a new ship with full hull and shields beside the nearest station in the same system, with the main quest, missions, reputation, the galaxy and the planets as they were. You lose your cargo and pay 10 % of your credits as insurance. Load Last Save and Main Menu are still there.

steps.title: The game plays itself
steps.text: Leave the title screen alone for 30 seconds and a fresh game starts, flown by an autopilot. It circles planets, landing on every third one to walk about the village for 35 seconds. It also visits stations and mines asteroids, runs a system scan every fourth task and takes a jump gate every seventh, and fights any pirate that comes within 900. Your ship can't die, nothing is saved and any dialogue that pops up is closed. Any key, click or real mouse movement brings you back to the title screen.

steps.title: PLEASE INSERT DRACHMA
steps.text: The banner that blinks during the demo is drawn pixel by pixel like an 80s arcade's INSERT COIN, on the same 8 x 8 grid with thick two-pixel strokes. Its letters are styled as ancient Greek: Λ for A, Σ for E, Δ for D, a squared S like a turn of the meander, and Greek capitals for the rest. Each letter shades from pale gold at the top to orange, with a hard dark shadow, and a band of Greek key runs above and below. No font file is needed: 13 letters, each a 7 x 7 bitmap.

steps.title: A CRT filter, in Settings
steps.text: During the demo the whole window looks like an old CRT: the picture bulges on curved glass with rounded black corners, with scanlines, red, green and blue phosphor stripes, colour fringes toward the edges, a darker rim, a faint flicker and a slow rolling band. It's now a setting. Settings has a CRT filter switch for the look all the time, off by default, and Tune... opens its own page. That page has the switch for attract mode (on by default) and a slider for each of the ten parameters, with the filter previewed live while the page is open.

review.intro: Patch 0005 brings signal sources (the scanner finds them, six encounters in pockets of empty space, the Void Leviathan and its bullet-hell orbs, the deathtrap field), Respawn instead of a new game on death, the title screen's attract mode with its arcade-Greek PLEASE INSERT DRACHMA banner, and the CRT filter with its own settings page; plus fixes for the creature's orbs breaking clicks, followed ships turning back and forth, dialogues keeping the mouse hidden, and 50 % louder voices. The big new pieces are signal_site.gd (the six encounters), space_monster.gd (the creature), attract_mode.gd (the autopilot and the banner) and crt_filter.gd with crt.gdshader.

A **system scan** (right-click empty space) locates them: a glowing path runs from your ship to each one while the scan lasts, then fades - but their **beacons** stay, in space, on your radar (diamonds) and on the system map. Click **ENTER** over a beacon to drop into it (from far away your ship flies there first): a pocket of empty space - no star, planets or stations - where something is going on. The panel at the bottom says what; **Leave** (or fly far out) takes you back beside the beacon. Finish one and it's gone; leave one unfinished and its beacon waits.

+- **Combat signal** - a freighter under attack by pirates. Kill them all while it lives and it pays you.
+- **Debris field** - a wreck with its cargo drifting round it (it doesn't expire). Scavengers may come for it too.
+- **Unknown bio-signature** - a **Void Leviathan**. It's tough and spits acid; dead, it leaves alien alloy, data cores and credits.
+- **Anomalous readings** - a space anomaly with four nodes. Fly close to each and right-click it to scan; all four give **Anomaly Research Data** (research stations pay well). Its core burns.

files.explanation: New: the title screen's attract mode. AttractMode.start() begins a fresh game with active (a static) set; main.gd and planet_surface.gd add a controller while it's on. In space it drives your ship through a cycle of tasks (planets, stations, mining, scans, gates, fights); on a planet it walks about and takes off. Banner draws PLEASE INSERT DRACHMA in pixel letters styled as ancient Greek. Any real input returns to the menu.

@@ -1,0 +1,312 @@ 
+class_name AttractMode
+extends Node
+## Attract mode: left alone on the title screen for IDLE seconds, the game
+## plays itself - a fresh game where an autopilot flies your ship round the
+## system: to the planets (circling them, sometimes landing and walking about
+## the village), past the stations, mining asteroids, fighting pirates that
+## come near, scanning, and through the jump gates to other systems. "PLEASE
+## INSERT DRACHMA" blinks slowly in big gold letters near the bottom (clear of
+## the HUD), and the whole window looks like an old CRT (CrtFilter, if
+## Settings.crt_attract - the default). Any key, click or real mouse
+## movement goes back to the menu.
+##
+## AttractMode.active (static) lasts across the scene changes (jumps, landing);
+## main.gd / planet_surface.gd add a controller (AttractMode.new()) while it's
+## on. Nothing is saved; your ship can't be destroyed meanwhile.
+
+const IDLE := 30.0
+const MENU := "res://scenes/ui/main_menu.tscn"
+const GAME := "res://main.tscn"
+const TASK_TIME := 22.0             # any task gives up after this long
+const SURFACE_TIME := 35.0          # walking about a planet, then take off
+const MOVE_TOLERANCE := 6.0         # mouse movement (px) that counts as "the user is back"
+
+static var active := false
+static var _ready_at := 0
+
+var host: Node                      # main.gd (space) or planet_surface.gd
+var task := ""
+var _task_t := 0.0
+var _goal: Node2D
+var _orbit_a := 0.0
+var _visits := 0
+var _moved := 0.0
+var _walk_t := 0.0
+var _label: Control
+var _t := 0.0
+
+
+## Starts it from the title screen: a fresh game, driven.
+static func start(tree: SceneTree) -> void:
+	active = true
+	_ready_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 1200   # (ignore input as the scene changes)
+	var sg := tree.root.get_node_or_null("SaveGame")
+	if sg:
+		sg.pending = {}
+		sg.travelling = false
+	tree.change_scene_to_file(GAME)
+
+
+## Back to the title screen.
+static func stop(tree: SceneTree) -> void:
+	if not active:
+		return
+	active = false
+	tree.paused = false
+	var sg := tree.root.get_node_or_null("SaveGame")
+	if sg:
+		sg.pending = {}
+		sg.travelling = false
+		sg.landed_planet = ""
+	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE
+	tree.change_scene_to_file(MENU)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	_build_banner()
+	if host.get("ship") != null:   # space
+		var ship: Node2D = host.ship
+		ship.invulnerable = true
+		host.set("_zoom", 0.75)
+		if host.get("hud") and host.hud.get("hint"):
+			host.hud.hint.visible = false
+
+
+func _build_banner() -> void:
+	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
+	layer.layer = 90
+	add_child(layer)
+	_label = Banner.new()
+	_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	# Bottom centre, above the toolbar (and clear of the event log on the left).
+	_label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM)
+	_label.offset_left = -440
+	_label.offset_right = 440
+	_label.offset_top = -265
+	_label.offset_bottom = -132
+	layer.add_child(_label)
+
+
+## The user is back: any key, click or real mouse movement.
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if Time.get_ticks_msec() < _ready_at:
+		return
+	var back := false
+	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed:
+		back = true
+	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
+		back = true
+	elif event is InputEventJoypadButton and event.pressed:
+		back = true
+	elif event is InputEventMouseMotion:
+		_moved += event.relative.length()
+		back = _moved > MOVE_TOLERANCE
+	if back:
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+		AttractMode.stop(get_tree())
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t += delta
+	_moved = maxf(0.0, _moved - delta * 20.0)   # (tiny jitters fade away)
+	# A slow blink: fading in and out over two and a half seconds.
+	_label.modulate.a = 0.15 + 0.85 * pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * TAU / 2.5), 1.5)
+	if get_tree().paused:
+		_unpause()
+	if host.get("ship") != null:
+		_drive_space(delta)
+	elif host.get("pilot") != null:
+		_drive_surface(delta)
+
+
+## A dialogue or panel popping up mid-demo: close it.
+func _unpause() -> void:
+	for n in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("dialogue_boxes"):
+		if n.visible and n.has_method("_finish"):
+			n._finish()
+	var d = host.get("quest")
+	if d and d.get("dialogue") and d.dialogue.visible:
+		d.dialogue._finish()
+	get_tree().paused = false
+
+
+# --- In space ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _drive_space(delta: float) -> void:
+	var ship: Node2D = host.ship
+	if not ship.is_alive() or host.get("site") != null:
+		return
+	_task_t += delta
+	# Pirates close by: fight them.
+	if task != "fight":
+		for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
+			if e.is_alive() and e.global_position.distance_to(ship.global_position) < 900.0:
+				_begin("fight", e)
+				ship.set_attack_target(e, true)
+				break
+	if task == "" or _task_t > TASK_TIME:
+		_next_task()
+	match task:
+		"fight":
+			if not is_instance_valid(_goal) or not _goal.is_alive():
+				_next_task()
+		"planet", "station":
+			if not is_instance_valid(_goal):
+				_next_task()
+				return
+			var c: Vector2 = _goal.global_position
+			var r: float = float(_goal.get("radius")) * 1.6 + 260.0 if _goal.get("radius") != null else 500.0
+			if ship.global_position.distance_to(c) > r + 400.0:
+				ship.move_to(c + (ship.global_position - c).normalized() * r)
+			else:   # circle it
+				_orbit_a += delta * 0.35
+				ship.move_to(c + Vector2.from_angle(_orbit_a) * r)
+				if task == "planet" and _task_t > 9.0 and _goal.get("landable") and _visits % 3 == 1:
+					task = "landing"
+					host.land_on(_goal.planet_id)
+		"mine":
+			if not is_instance_valid(_goal) or not _goal.is_alive():
+				_next_task()
+		"gate":
+			if not is_instance_valid(_goal):
+				_next_task()
+				return
+			ship.move_to(_goal.global_position)
+			if ship.global_position.distance_to(_goal.global_position) < 700.0:
+				task = "jumping"
+				host.jump_to(_goal.target)
+
+
+func _begin(t: String, goal: Node2D) -> void:
+	task = t
+	_goal = goal
+	_task_t = 0.0
+
+
+## The next thing to do: mostly planets and stations, now and then a rock,
+## a scan, or a gate to the next system.
+func _next_task() -> void:
+	var ship: Node2D = host.ship
+	ship.set_attack_target(null)
+	_visits += 1
+	if _visits % 4 == 0 and host.get("scanner"):
+		host.scanner.scan_system()
+	var roll := _visits % 7
+	var pick: Node2D = null
+	if roll == 6:
+		pick = _random_in("gates")
+		if pick:
+			_begin("gate", pick)
+			return
+	if roll == 3:
+		pick = _nearest_in("asteroids", ship.global_position)
+		if pick:
+			_begin("mine", pick)
+			ship.set_attack_target(pick, true)
+			return
+	if roll in [2, 5]:
+		pick = _random_in("stations")
+		if pick:
+			_begin("station", pick)
+			return
+	var planets := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("planet_bodies").filter(func(b): return b.parent_body == null)
+	if not planets.is_empty():
+		_begin("planet", planets.pick_random())
+		_orbit_a = (ship.global_position - _goal.global_position).angle()
+		return
+	_begin("station", _random_in("stations"))
+
+
+func _random_in(group: String) -> Node2D:
+	var all := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group(group)
+	return all.pick_random() if not all.is_empty() else null
+
+
+func _nearest_in(group: String, p: Vector2) -> Node2D:
+	var best: Node2D = null
+	for n in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group(group):
+		if best == null or p.distance_to(n.global_position) < p.distance_to(best.global_position):
+			best = n
+	return best
+
+
+# --- On a planet ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _drive_surface(delta: float) -> void:
+	var pilot: Node2D = host.pilot
+	if pilot == null or not host.has_method("_walk_to"):
+		return
+	_task_t += delta
+	if _task_t > SURFACE_TIME:
+		_task_t = -INF
+		host.take_off()
+		return
+	_walk_t -= delta
+	if _walk_t <= 0.0 or (not pilot.moving and _walk_t < 4.0):
+		_walk_t = randf_range(5.0, 8.0)
+		for k in 12:   # somewhere open, a little way off
+			var p: Vector2 = pilot.position + Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(300.0, 700.0)
+			if host.walkable_at(p):
+				host._walk_to(p)
+				break
+
+
+## "PLEASE INSERT DRACHMA" the 80s arcade way - blocky letters on an 8 x 8 pixel
+## grid like an "INSERT COIN" - but styled as ancient Greek: Λ for A, Σ for E,
+## Δ for D, a squared S and C, between two bands of meander (Greek key). Drawn

@@ -1,0 +1,634 @@ 
+class_name SignalSite
+extends Node2D
+## A signal source you've dropped into (SignalSites, from a SignalBeacon's
+## ENTER): a pocket of empty space - no star, planets or stations, only the
+## deep sky - where its encounter plays out. It lives far out in the space
+## scene (ORIGIN), so ships, weapons, loot and the HUD all work as anywhere;
+## main.site points at it while you're here. A panel at the top says what's
+## going on (at the bottom, above the toolbar), with a Leave button (or fly out past BOUNDS); you come back out
+## beside the beacon. Finishing it (done) marks the signal done - it won't
+## be there next time. Saving here saves you at the beacon.
+##
+##   stranded     a ship out of fuel: fly up to it and transfer 5 fuel (or rig
+##                its drive with 2 energy cells) - credits and its empire's
+##                thanks; one time in three it was bait, and pirates jump you
+##   under_attack a freighter (tougher than usual) fighting 3-4 pirates: kill
+##                them while it lives for its reward
+##   wreck        a wrecked hull, 10-14 pieces of loot drifting round it (kept,
+##                not expiring); scavengers may turn up
+##   monster      a Void Leviathan: kill it for alien alloy, data cores, credits
+##   anomaly      a swirling anomaly with four nodes round it: right-click each
+##                (close up) to scan it - research data for all four; its core
+##                burns
+##   deathtrap    a 5,200-long field of unstable anomalies (draining shields,
+##                then burning the hull) with one winding safe line through;
+##                its exit holds the prize. Flying out of the field's sides
+##                leaves the site with nothing.
+
+const ORIGIN := Vector2(240000.0, 240000.0)
+const BOUNDS := 7000.0              # this far from ORIGIN: you leave the site
+const STRANDED_REACH := 420.0
+const HAZARD_DRAIN := 45.0          # per second inside a hazard (shields, then hull)
+const CORE_BURN := 30.0
+const FIELD_LENGTH := 5200.0
+const FIELD_HALF_WIDTH := 1800.0
+
+var main: Node
+var sig: Dictionary = {}
+var kind := ""
+var return_point := Vector2.ZERO
+var done := false
+var status := ""
+var in_hazard := false
+var spawned: Array = []             # ships made here (freed on leaving)
+var hazards: Array = []             # deathtrap: [{pos, r, ph}]
+var path: PackedVector2Array        # deathtrap: the safe line through (entry -> exit)
+var exit_point := Vector2.ZERO
+var scan_points: Array = []         # anomaly: ScanNode
+var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+var _t := 0.0
+var _victim: Node2D                 # stranded / under_attack: the ship to help
+var _pirates: Array = []
+var _monster: Node2D
+var _loot: Array = []
+var _ambush := false
+var _ambushed := false
+var _leaving := false
+var _layer: CanvasLayer
+var _title: Label
+var _status: Label
+var _action: Button
+var _warn: Label
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	z_index = -1
+
+
+## Builds the encounter and brings the ship in.
+func start() -> void:
+	kind = str(sig.get("kind", "wreck"))
+	_rng.seed = int(sig.get("seed", 1))
+	position = Vector2.ZERO
+	_build_ui()
+	var ship: Node2D = main.ship
+	ship.stop()
+	ship.set_attack_target(null)
+	ship.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+	var entry := ORIGIN
+	match kind:
+		"stranded": _build_stranded()
+		"under_attack": _build_under_attack()
+		"wreck": _build_wreck()
+		"monster": _build_monster()
+		"anomaly": _build_anomaly()
+		"deathtrap":
+			_build_deathtrap()
+			entry = path[0]
+	ship.global_position = entry
+	ship.rotation = (exit_point - entry).angle() + PI / 2.0 if kind == "deathtrap" else 0.0
+	main.get_node("Ship/Camera2D").reset_smoothing()
+	_fade_in()
+	Sfx.play("space/jump")
+	GameLog.post("Dropped into the signal source: %s." % SignalSites.info(kind)["name"], "mission")
+
+
+func title() -> String:
+	return SignalSites.info(kind)["name"]
+
+
+func _say(text: String) -> void:
+	status = text
+	if _status:
+		_status.text = text
+
+
+## Done: the signal won't be there again.
+func complete(text: String) -> void:
+	if done:
+		return
+	done = true
+	sig["done"] = true
+	_say(text + "  ·  Leave when you're ready.")
+	GameLog.post("Signal source: " + text, "good")
+	Sfx.play("space/scan_done")
+
+
+# --- The encounters ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _civilian_type() -> String:
+	var ids: Array = EnemyTypes.neutral_ids().filter(func(id): return EnemyTypes.get_type(id).get("role", "") == "trader")
+	if ids.is_empty():
+		ids = EnemyTypes.neutral_ids()
+	return ids[_rng.randi() % ids.size()]
+
+
+func _empire() -> String:
+	var e: String = Galaxy.owner_of(Galaxy.current_system)
+	return Galaxy.HOME_EMPIRE if e == "pirates" else e
+
+
+func _spawn(at: Vector2, type_id := "", empire := "pirates") -> Node2D:
+	var s: Node2D = main.spawn_ship(at, type_id, {}, empire)
+	s.home = at
+	spawned.append(s)
+	return s
+
+
+func _pirate_wave(n: int, around: Vector2, dist: float) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for i in n:
+		out.append(_spawn(around + Vector2.from_angle(_rng.randf() * TAU) * dist))
+	return out
+
+
+func _build_stranded() -> void:
+	_victim = _spawn(ORIGIN + Vector2(0, -900), _civilian_type(), _empire())
+	_victim.max_speed = 0.0
+	_victim.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+	_victim.display_name = "Stranded " + _victim.display_name
+	_ambush = _rng.randf() < 0.35
+	_say("A %s is drifting without fuel. Fly up to it and transfer 5 fuel (or 2 energy cells)." % _victim.display_name)
+
+
+func _build_under_attack() -> void:
+	_victim = _spawn(ORIGIN + Vector2(0, -1100), _civilian_type(), _empire())
+	_victim.max_hull *= 3.0
+	_victim.hull = _victim.max_hull
+	_victim.max_speed *= 0.4
+	_victim.cargo = {"machinery": 12, "electronics": 8}
+	_pirates = _pirate_wave(_rng.randi_range(3, 4), _victim.global_position, 380.0)
+	_say("Pirates are attacking a %s. Destroy them before they destroy it." % _victim.display_name)
+
+
+func _build_wreck() -> void:
+	var at := ORIGIN + Vector2(0, -800)
+	var w := Wreck.new()
+	w.position = at
+	w.seed_ = int(sig.get("seed", 1))
+	add_child(w)
+	var table := [["scrap", 2, 4], ["scrap", 2, 4], ["energy_cell", 1, 3], ["alien_alloy", 1, 2], ["credits", 40, 140],
+		["credits", 40, 140], ["repair_kit", 1, 1], ["missile", 2, 4], ["machinery", 2, 5], ["electronics", 2, 4]]
+	for i in _rng.randi_range(10, 14):
+		var e: Array = table[_rng.randi() % table.size()]
+		_drop(at + Vector2.from_angle(_rng.randf() * TAU) * _rng.randf_range(120.0, 520.0), e[0], _rng.randi_range(e[1], e[2]))
+	if _rng.randf() < 0.4:
+		_drop(at + Vector2.from_angle(_rng.randf() * TAU) * 200.0, "data_core", 1)
+	_ambush = _rng.randf() < 0.3
+	_say("A wrecked ship, its cargo drifting round it. Collect the salvage (%d pieces)." % _loot.size())
+
+
+func _build_monster() -> void:
+	_monster = _spawn(ORIGIN + Vector2(0, -1300), "void_leviathan", "pirates")
+	_monster.aggro_range = 950.0
+	Sfx.play("space/monster_roar")
+	_say("Something enormous is here: a Void Leviathan. Kill it - its hide is laced with alien alloy.")
+
+
+func _build_anomaly() -> void:
+	var core := Anomaly.new()
+	core.position = ORIGIN + Vector2(0, -1200)
+	add_child(core)
+	for i in 4:
+		var n := ScanNode.new()
+		n.site = self
+		n.position = core.position + Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / 4.0 + _rng.randf_range(-0.3, 0.3)) * _rng.randf_range(650.0, 950.0)
+		n.display_name = "Anomaly node %d" % (i + 1)
+		add_child(n)
+		scan_points.append(n)
+	_say("A space anomaly. Fly close to each of its 4 nodes and right-click it to scan (0 / 4). Keep clear of the core.")
+
+
+func _build_deathtrap() -> void:
+	var dir := Vector2.from_angle(_rng.randf() * TAU)
+	var side := dir.orthogonal()
+	var start := ORIGIN - dir * FIELD_LENGTH * 0.5
+	# The safe line: a winding path from the entry to the exit.
+	path = PackedVector2Array()
+	var n := 7
+	for i in n + 1:
+		var lat := 0.0 if i == 0 or i == n else _rng.randf_range(-900.0, 900.0)
+		path.append(start + dir * (FIELD_LENGTH * i / n) + side * lat)
+	exit_point = path[path.size() - 1]
+	# Hazards everywhere else in the field, clear of the line.
+	var step := 300.0
+	var x := 250.0
+	while x < FIELD_LENGTH - 250.0:
+		var y := -FIELD_HALF_WIDTH + 150.0
+		while y < FIELD_HALF_WIDTH - 150.0:
+			var p := start + dir * (x + _rng.randf_range(-80, 80)) + side * (y + _rng.randf_range(-80, 80))
+			var r := _rng.randf_range(140.0, 230.0)
+			if _dist_to_path(p) > r + 210.0:
+				hazards.append({"pos": p, "r": r, "ph": _rng.randf() * TAU})
+			y += step
+		x += step
+	_say("An unstable anomaly field. Its storms drain shields and burn hulls - follow the gaps to the exit beacon. Fly out of the sides and you lose the prize.")
+
+
+func _dist_to_path(p: Vector2) -> float:
+	var best := INF
+	for i in path.size() - 1:
+		best = minf(best, p.distance_to(Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(p, path[i], path[i + 1])))
+	return best
+
+
+## Loot that stays (doesn't expire) until you take it.
+func _drop(at: Vector2, id: String, n: int) -> Pickup:
+	var p := Pickup.spawn(get_tree(), at, id, n)
+	p.permanent = true
+	p.velocity *= 0.15
+	_loot.append(p)
+	return p
+
+
+# --- Running ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t += delta
+	if _leaving or main == null:
+		return
+	var ship: Node2D = main.ship
+	if not ship.is_alive():
+		return
+	in_hazard = false
+	match kind:
+		"stranded": _run_stranded(ship)
+		"under_attack": _run_under_attack()
+		"wreck": _run_wreck(ship)
+		"monster": _run_monster()
+		"anomaly": _run_anomaly(ship, delta)
+		"deathtrap": _run_deathtrap(ship, delta)
+	if _warn:
+		_warn.visible = in_hazard
+	if ship.global_position.distance_to(ORIGIN) > BOUNDS or (kind == "deathtrap" and not done and _outside_field(ship.global_position)):
+		leave()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _run_stranded(ship: Node2D) -> void:
+	if done or not is_instance_valid(_victim) or not _victim.is_alive():
+		_action.visible = false
+		if not done and not is_instance_valid(_victim):
+			done = true
+			sig["done"] = true
+			_say("The stranded ship is lost.  ·  Leave when you're ready.")
+		return
+	_victim.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+	var d := ship.global_position.distance_to(_victim.global_position)
+	if _ambush and not _ambushed and d < 900.0:
+		_ambushed = true
+		_pirates = _pirate_wave(2, ship.global_position, 1300.0)
+		main.hud.flash_message("It was bait - pirates are jumping you!")
+		GameLog.post("The distress call was a trap: pirates incoming.", "danger")
+	_action.visible = d < STRANDED_REACH
+	var data: Node = main.player_data
+	if data.count("fuel") >= 5:
+		_action.text = "Transfer 5 fuel"
+		_action.disabled = false
+	elif data.count("energy_cell") >= 2:
+		_action.text = "Rig their drive (2 energy cells)"
+		_action.disabled = false
+	else:
+		_action.text = "No fuel aboard - buy 5 at a market"
+		_action.disabled = true
+
+
+func _help_stranded() -> void:
+	var data: Node = main.player_data
+	if not data.remove_item("fuel", 5) and not data.remove_item("energy_cell", 2):
+		return
+	var pay := _rng.randi_range(250, 550)
+	data.add_credits(pay)
+	if _victim.empire != "" and _victim.empire != "pirates":
+		Galaxy.change_reputation(_victim.empire, 3.0)
+	_victim.max_speed = EnemyTypes.get_type(_victim.type_id)["speed"]
+	_victim.leg_target = _victim.global_position + Vector2.from_angle(_rng.randf() * TAU) * 9000.0
+	_victim.has_leg = true
+	_action.visible = false
+	complete("You refuelled the %s. They paid %d credits and their empire won't forget it." % [_victim.display_name, pay])
+
+
+func _run_under_attack() -> void:
+	if done:
+		return
+	_pirates = _pirates.filter(func(p): return is_instance_valid(p) and p.is_alive())
+	var alive: bool = is_instance_valid(_victim) and _victim.is_alive()
+	if _pirates.is_empty():
+		if alive:
+			var pay := _rng.randi_range(450, 850)
+			main.player_data.add_credits(pay)
+			if _victim.empire != "" and _victim.empire != "pirates":
+				Galaxy.change_reputation(_victim.empire, 4.0)
+			_victim.max_speed = EnemyTypes.get_type(_victim.type_id)["speed"]
+			_victim.leg_target = _victim.global_position + Vector2.from_angle(_rng.randf() * TAU) * 9000.0
+			_victim.has_leg = true
+			complete("You saved the %s - it sent %d credits as thanks." % [_victim.display_name, pay])
+		else:
+			complete("The pirates are dead, but the freighter was lost. Its cargo is drifting where it died.")
+	elif not alive:
+		_say("The freighter is lost. %d pirates remain." % _pirates.size())
+	else:
+		_say("Pirates attacking the %s: %d left. Its hull: %d %%." % [_victim.display_name, _pirates.size(), int(_victim.hull / _victim.max_hull * 100.0)])
+
+
+func _run_wreck(ship: Node2D) -> void:
+	_loot = _loot.filter(func(p): return is_instance_valid(p))
+	if _ambush and not _ambushed and _t > 12.0:
+		_ambushed = true
+		_pirate_wave(_rng.randi_range(2, 3), ship.global_position, 1400.0)
+		main.hud.flash_message("Scavengers - pirates want the salvage too!")
+		GameLog.post("Pirate scavengers arrive at the wreck.", "danger")
+	if done:
+		return
+	if _loot.is_empty():
+		complete("You stripped the wreck of everything worth taking.")
+	else:
+		_say("A wrecked ship, its cargo drifting round it: %d pieces of salvage left." % _loot.size())
+
+
+func _run_monster() -> void:
+	if done:
+		return
+	if not is_instance_valid(_monster) or not _monster.is_alive():
+		var at: Vector2 = _monster.global_position if is_instance_valid(_monster) else ORIGIN
+		_drop(at, "alien_alloy", _rng.randi_range(3, 5))
+		_drop(at + Vector2(40, 0), "data_core", _rng.randi_range(1, 2))
+		_drop(at + Vector2(-40, 20), "credits", _rng.randi_range(500, 900))
+		complete("The Void Leviathan is dead. Its body is breaking up - collect what it leaves.")
+	else:
+		_say("The Void Leviathan: %d %% left." % int(_monster.hull / _monster.max_hull * 100.0))
+
+
+func _run_anomaly(ship: Node2D, delta: float) -> void:
+	var core: Node2D = null
+	for c in get_children():
+		if c is Anomaly:
+			core = c
+	if core and ship.global_position.distance_to(core.global_position) < core.RADIUS:
+		in_hazard = true
+		ship.hazard_damage(CORE_BURN * delta, core.global_position)
+	if done:
+		return
+	var n := scan_points.filter(func(s): return s.scanned).size()
+	if n >= scan_points.size():
+		_drop(ship.global_position + Vector2(60, 0), "research_data", 2)
+		_drop(ship.global_position + Vector2(-60, 0), "credits", 150)
+		complete("All four nodes scanned: 2 Anomaly Research Data (research stations pay well).")
+	else:
+		_say("A space anomaly: %d / %d nodes scanned. Fly close to a node and right-click it. Keep clear of the core." % [n, scan_points.size()])
+
+
+## The node under `world` a right-click scans (anomaly sites), or null.
+func scan_point_at(world: Vector2) -> Node2D:
+	for s in scan_points:
+		if not s.scanned and s.global_position.distance_to(world) < s.hit_radius * 1.6:
+			return s
+	return null
+
+
+func _run_deathtrap(ship: Node2D, delta: float) -> void:
+	var p: Vector2 = ship.global_position
+	for h in hazards:
+		if p.distance_to(h["pos"]) < _hazard_r(h) + 20.0:
+			in_hazard = true
+			ship.hazard_damage(HAZARD_DRAIN * delta, h["pos"])
+			break
+	if not done and p.distance_to(exit_point) < 220.0:
+		_drop(exit_point + Vector2(80, 0), "alien_alloy", _rng.randi_range(2, 3))
+		_drop(exit_point + Vector2(-80, 0), "data_core", 1)
+		_drop(exit_point + Vector2(0, 80), "credits", _rng.randi_range(400, 700))
+		complete("You crossed the anomaly field. Its heart held a cache of exotic salvage.")
+
+
+func _hazard_r(h: Dictionary) -> float:
+	return float(h["r"]) * (1.0 + 0.08 * sin(_t * 1.7 + float(h["ph"])))
+
+
+func _outside_field(p: Vector2) -> bool:
+	var a := path[0]
+	var dir := (exit_point - a).normalized()
+	var along := (p - a).dot(dir)
+	var lat := absf((p - a).dot(dir.orthogonal()))
+	return lat > FIELD_HALF_WIDTH + 150.0 or along < -500.0 or along > FIELD_LENGTH + 500.0
+
+
+## Back out beside the beacon; everything made here goes.
+func leave() -> void:
+	if _leaving:
+		return
+	_leaving = true
+	for s in spawned:
+		if is_instance_valid(s):
+			s.queue_free()
+	for p in _loot:
+		if is_instance_valid(p):
+			p.queue_free()
+	for p in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("pickups"):
+		if p.global_position.distance_to(ORIGIN) < BOUNDS * 1.5:
+			p.queue_free()
+	for o in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("monster_orbs"):
+		o.queue_free()
+	var ship: Node2D = main.ship
+	ship.stop()
+	ship.set_attack_target(null)
+	ship.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+	ship.global_position = return_point
+	main.get_node("Ship/Camera2D").reset_smoothing()
+	main.site = null
+	Sfx.play("space/jump")
+	GameLog.post("Left the signal source%s." % ("" if done else " (unfinished - its beacon is still there)"), "mission")
+	_fade_in()
+	_layer.queue_free()
+	queue_free()
+
+
+func _fade_in() -> void:
+	var l := CanvasLayer.new()
+	l.layer = 60
+	var r := ColorRect.new()
+	r.color = Color(0.85, 0.9, 1.0, 1.0)
+	r.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	r.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	l.add_child(r)
+	main.add_child(l)
+	var tw := l.create_tween()
+	tw.tween_property(r, "color", Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.08, 0.0), 0.7).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
+	tw.tween_callback(l.queue_free)
+
+
+# --- The panel ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _build_ui() -> void:
+	_layer = CanvasLayer.new()
+	_layer.layer = 4
+	main.add_child(_layer)
+	var box := PanelContainer.new()
+	var st := UI.panel_style(SignalSites.info(kind)["color"])
+	st.bg_color = Color(0.04, 0.06, 0.12, 0.88)
+	st.content_margin_left = 16
+	st.content_margin_right = 16
+	st.content_margin_top = 8
+	st.content_margin_bottom = 8
+	box.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", st)
+	box.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM)   # (above the toolbar: the top has the system's name and boss bars)
+	box.position = Vector2(-330, -215)
+	box.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(660, 0)
+	box.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
+	_layer.add_child(box)
+	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
+	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	box.add_child(v)
+	var top := HBoxContainer.new()
+	v.add_child(top)
+	_title = UI.label("SIGNAL SOURCE  ·  " + SignalSites.info(kind)["name"].to_upper(), 17, SignalSites.info(kind)["color"])
+	_title.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	top.add_child(_title)

+		for k in 4:

+
+
+## The anomaly's core: a swirl of light; flying into it burns.
+class Anomaly extends Node2D:
+	const RADIUS := 320.0
+	var _t := 0.0
+
+	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+		_t += delta
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	func _draw() -> void:

+

+class_name SignalSites
+## Signal sources: points of interest hidden in every star system, found by a
+## system scan (ShipScanner, right-click in empty space). Each is a kind of
+## encounter - a classic of space games - played out in a pocket
+## of empty space you drop into from its beacon (SignalBeacon -> SignalSite):
+##   stranded     a ship out of fuel calls for help (give it fuel: a reward -
+##                sometimes it's bait and pirates jump you)
+##   under_attack a freighter fighting off pirates (save it: its thanks)
+##   wreck        a shipwreck with its cargo scattered round it (loot; maybe
+##                scavengers)
+##   monster      an alien creature; it drops rare loot when it dies
+##   anomaly      a space anomaly: scan its four nodes for research data
+##   deathtrap    a field of unstable anomalies that drain your shields and
+##                burn your hull - cross it to its exit for what's there
+## Each system gets a fresh set every EPOCH seconds of galaxy time (the ones
+## you've found and not finished stay). Galaxy.signals_in() keeps them.
+
+const EPOCH := 1200.0
+const KINDS := {
+	"stranded": {"name": "Distress call", "detail": "A ship is calling for help - out of fuel.", "color": Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.3)},
+	"under_attack": {"name": "Combat signal", "detail": "Weapons fire - a freighter under attack.", "color": Color(1.0, 0.4, 0.3)},
+	"wreck": {"name": "Debris field", "detail": "A wrecked ship, its cargo drifting round it.", "color": Color(0.7, 0.8, 0.9)},
+	"monster": {"name": "Unknown bio-signature", "detail": "Something alive and very large.", "color": Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55)},
+	"anomaly": {"name": "Anomalous readings", "detail": "A space anomaly - scan it for research data.", "color": Color(0.5, 0.75, 1.0)},
+	"deathtrap": {"name": "Hazard: anomaly field", "detail": "Unstable anomalies drain shields and burn hulls. Something waits at the far side.", "color": Color(0.85, 0.45, 1.0)},
+}
+
+
+## A system's signals for one epoch: 3-4 of different kinds, 4,500-12,500
+## from the star (the same every time for the same system and epoch).
+static func generate(sys_id: String, epoch: int) -> Array:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = hash("%s:%d" % [sys_id, epoch])
+	var kinds: Array = KINDS.keys()
+	for k in range(kinds.size() - 1, 0, -1):
+		var m := rng.randi() % (k + 1)
+		var t = kinds[k]
+		kinds[k] = kinds[m]
+		kinds[m] = t
+	var out := []
+	for i in rng.randi_range(3, 4):
+		var p := Vector2.from_angle(rng.randf() * TAU) * rng.randf_range(4500.0, 12500.0)
+		out.append({"id": "%s:%d:%d" % [sys_id, epoch, i], "kind": kinds[i], "pos": [p.x, p.y],
+			"located": false, "done": false, "seed": rng.randi()})
+	return out
+
+
+static func info(kind: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return KINDS.get(kind, KINDS["wreck"])
+
+
+static func pos(sig: Dictionary) -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(float(sig["pos"][0]), float(sig["pos"][1]))

+class_name SpaceMonster
+extends Node2D
+## The look and the attacks of an alien creature (EnemyTypes.MONSTERS): an
+## Enemy whose ship picture is hidden (Enemy._apply_type) and this in its
+## place. Head toward -y (the way a ship's nose points).
+##
+## Drawn in layers, all moving: tentacles that writhe in travelling waves
+## (suckers, glowing tips, curling at the ends), two fins that beat, a body of
+## overlapping plates that undulates along its spine with rim light and dark
+## mottling, veins of light pulsing from head to tail, eyes that track you and
+## blink, mandibles that open as it charges, a ball of energy gathering in
+## its maw.
+##
+## It doesn't fire like a ship (Enemy._shoot skips monsters): it attacks in
+## bullet-hell patterns of slow glowing orbs (Orb) - rings with a gap to slip
+## through, spinning spirals, aimed fans, curving blooms - each telegraphed by
+## a CHARGE (its maw glowing, the mandibles opening), PAUSE seconds apart. The
+## orbs are slower than your ship and your hitbox against them is smaller
+## than your hull (HITBOX), so they're hard to dodge but always dodgeable.
+
+const PATTERNS := ["ring", "spiral", "fan", "bloom"]
+const CHARGE := 0.7
+const PAUSE := 1.6
+const REACH := 1400.0               # attacks only a target this close
+const ORB_DAMAGE := 7.0
+const ORB_COLOR := Color(0.55, 1.0, 0.45)
+const ORB_COLOR_2 := Color(0.85, 0.45, 1.0)
+
+var length := 260.0
+var enemy: Node2D                   # the Enemy it belongs to
+var body_color := Color(0.1, 0.27, 0.3)
+var glow := Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.6)
+var pattern := ""                   # the attack under way ("" none)
+var orbs_fired := 0
+var _t := 0.0
+var _pt := 0.0                      # time into the attack (negative: charging)
+var _cool := 2.0
+var _next := 0
+var _emit := 0.0
+var _spin := 0.0
+var _blink := 3.0
+var _look := Vector2.UP             # where the eyes look (local)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	_t = randf() * 10.0
+	_spin = randf() * TAU
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t += delta
+	_blink -= delta
+	if _blink < -0.15:
+		_blink = randf_range(2.0, 5.0)
+	var tgt := _target()
+	if tgt:
+		_look = _look.lerp(to_local(tgt.global_position).normalized(), minf(1.0, delta * 4.0))
+	_attack(delta, tgt)
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _target() -> Node2D:
+	if enemy == null or not is_instance_valid(enemy) or not enemy.is_alive():
+		return null
+	var t = enemy.get("_target")
+	if t is Node2D and is_instance_valid(t) and t.is_alive() and t.global_position.distance_to(global_position) < REACH:
+		return t
+	return null
+
+
+# --- Attacks -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _attack(delta: float, tgt: Node2D) -> void:
+	if pattern == "":
+		_cool -= delta
+		if _cool <= 0.0 and tgt != null:
+			pattern = PATTERNS[_next % PATTERNS.size()]
+			_next += 1
+			_pt = -CHARGE
+			_emit = 0.0
+			Sfx.play_world("space/monster_roar", global_position, -8.0, 0.15)
+		return
+	var before := _pt
+	_pt += delta
+	if _pt < 0.0:
+		return
+	var aim := (tgt.global_position - mouth()).angle() if tgt else global_rotation - PI / 2.0
+	var crossed := func(at: float) -> bool: return before < at and _pt >= at
+	var end := 0.0
+	match pattern:
+		"ring":   # two rings, the second turned half a step: weave through the gaps
+			for k in 2:
+				if crossed.call(k * 0.6):
+					_ring(18, 155.0, _spin + k * PI / 18.0, ORB_COLOR)
+			end = 0.7
+		"spiral":   # two arms turning: circle round it against the spin
+			_emit -= delta
+			while _emit <= 0.0 and _pt < 2.6:
+				_emit += 0.09
+				_spin += 0.31
+				for arm in 2:
+					_orb(Vector2.from_angle(_spin + arm * PI) * 175.0, ORB_COLOR_2)
+			end = 2.7
+		"fan":   # three aimed fans of seven: sidestep
+			for k in 3:
+				if crossed.call(k * 0.45):
+					for i in 7:
+						_orb(Vector2.from_angle(aim + (i - 3) * 0.12) * 235.0, ORB_COLOR)
+			end = 1.0
+		"bloom":   # four rings whose orbs curve, alternately left and right
+			for k in 4:
+				if crossed.call(k * 0.5):
+					var curve := 0.55 if k % 2 == 0 else -0.55
+					for i in 10:
+						var o := _orb(Vector2.from_angle(_spin + i * TAU / 10.0 + k * 0.3) * 145.0, ORB_COLOR_2)
+						o.curve = curve
+			end = 1.7
+	if _pt >= end:
+		pattern = ""
+		_cool = PAUSE
+		_spin += 1.1
+
+
+func mouth() -> Vector2:
+	return to_global(Vector2(0, -length * 0.5))
+
+
+func _ring(n: int, speed: float, offset: float, col: Color) -> void:
+	for i in n:
+		_orb(Vector2.from_angle(offset + i * TAU / n) * speed, col)
+
+
+func _orb(vel: Vector2, col: Color) -> Orb:
+	var o := Orb.new()
+	o.velocity = vel
+	o.color = col
+	o.damage = ORB_DAMAGE
+	o.source = enemy
+	# In the effects layer - never among the ships (code walking the enemies
+	# node expects only ships there: click picking, saving...).
+	var parent: Node = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("fx_layer")
+	if parent == null:
+		parent = get_tree().current_scene if get_tree().current_scene else get_parent()

+

+
+## The spine's sideways sway at s (0 head .. 1 tail): a wave running back.
+func _sway(s: float) -> float:

+
+
+func _draw() -> void:

+	var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 2.0)

+	_draw_tentacles(L, pulse)
+	# A soft halo, brighter when it charges.
+	for k in 5:   # (layered, so its edge is soft)
+		draw_circle(Vector2(0, -L * 0.1), L * (0.46 - k * 0.06), Color(glow, (0.012 + 0.01 * pulse + 0.02 * charge) * (k + 1) * 0.6))
+	_draw_fins(L)
+	# The body: plates from tail to head (the head's drawn last, on top).
+	var segs := [[0.95, 0.07], [0.8, 0.1], [0.66, 0.13], [0.52, 0.16], [0.38, 0.19], [0.25, 0.2], [0.13, 0.18], [0.03, 0.15]]
+	for sg in segs:
+		var s: float = sg[0]
+		var c := Vector2(_sway(s), lerpf(-0.42, 0.2, s) * L)
+		var r: float = sg[1] * L * (1.0 + 0.04 * sin(_t * 2.6 + s * 6.0))
+		draw_circle(c, r, body_color.darkened(0.25))
+		draw_circle(c + Vector2(-r * 0.12, -r * 0.1), r * 0.88, body_color)
+		draw_circle(c + Vector2(-r * 0.25, -r * 0.25), r * 0.45, body_color.lightened(0.08))
+		draw_arc(c, r * 0.97, PI * 1.05, PI * 1.95, 18, Color(glow, 0.45), 2.0, true)   # rim light
+		for m in 3:   # dark mottling
+			var a := s * 17.0 + m * 2.1
+			draw_circle(c + Vector2.from_angle(a) * r * 0.55, r * 0.12, Color(0.03, 0.08, 0.1, 0.5))
+	# Veins of light, a pulse running from head to tail.
+	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+		for i in 14:
+			var s := i / 13.0
+			pts.append(Vector2(_sway(s) + side * L * 0.07 * sin(PI * clampf(s * 1.1, 0.0, 1.0)), lerpf(-0.36, 0.17, s) * L))
+		draw_polyline(pts, Color(glow, 0.25), 2.0, true)
+		var head_s := fmod(_t * 0.7, 1.0)
+		for i in pts.size():
+			var d := absf(i / 13.0 - head_s)
+			if d < 0.12:
+				draw_circle(pts[i], 3.5 * (1.0 - d / 0.12) + 1.0, Color(glow.lightened(0.3), 0.9 * (1.0 - d / 0.12)))
+	# Glowing spots along its back.
+	for i in 8:
+		var s := 0.1 + i * 0.1
+		var p := Vector2(_sway(s), lerpf(-0.42, 0.2, s) * L)
+		draw_circle(p, 2.5 + 1.5 * sin(_t * 4.0 - i), Color(glow, 0.5 + 0.4 * pulse))

+
+
+func _draw_tentacles(L: float, pulse: float) -> void:
+	for k in 8:
+		var side := (k - 3.5) / 3.5
+		var root := Vector2(_sway(0.85) + side * L * 0.12, L * 0.14)
+		var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+		var long := L * (0.55 + 0.12 * ((k * 7) % 3) / 2.0)
+		for i in 18:
+			var u := i / 17.0
+			var wave := sin(_t * 3.2 - u * 6.0 + k * 0.8) * L * 0.1 * u
+			var curl := Vector2(sin(_t * 1.3 + k), 0) * L * 0.08 * pow(u, 3.0)
+			pts.append(root + Vector2(side * L * 0.26 * u + wave, u * long) + curl)
